title: Sort an Array
summary: Return the input values in ascending order, keeping every repeated occurrence.
statement: Return the input values in ascending order, keeping every repeated occurrence. Implement the sorting logic without calling a built-in sorting routine.

examples.explanation: The only item is already sorted.
Both ends of the value range are supported.

constraints: 1–50000 entries in [−50000,50000]. Target O(n log n) time or better for this domain.
hints: Conceptual: Negative and positive values both belong in the output.
Directional: A bounded value range allows you to count occurrences.
Implementation: Offset values into a frequency array and emit each value as often as it occurred.
complexityAnalysis: O(n+U) time and O(U) auxiliary space for a frequency array over the occupied value range U.
